title.original: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
title.zh: Embodied.cpp：面向异构机器人的具身 AI 模型便携式推理运行时
title.en: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots

inclusion_reason.zh: Embodied.cpp 的五层接口、多速率闭环、融合推理与统一后端可跨 VLA/WAM、机器人和模拟器复用。
inclusion_reason.en: Embodied.cpp's five-layer interfaces, multi-rate control loop, fused inference, and unified backend are reusable across VLA/WAM models, robots, and simulators.

abstract.zh: Embodied.cpp 将 VLA 与世界动作模型的共同执行路径抽象为五层 C++ 运行时，支持多速率闭环、batch-1 融合推理和异构机器人后端。
abstract.en: Embodied.cpp abstracts the shared execution path of VLA and world-action models into a five-layer C++ runtime supporting multi-rate control loops, fused batch-one inference, and heterogeneous robot backends.

problem.zh: 具身模型分散在模型专用 Python 栈、后端假设和机器人胶水代码中，通用请求—响应推理服务又不满足闭环控制的多速率和低时延契约。
problem.en: Embodied models are fragmented across model-specific Python stacks, backend assumptions, and robot glue, while request-response servers do not meet multi-rate, latency-first closed-loop contracts.

approach.zh: 作者分析代表性 VLA/WAM 后提取共享路径，将输入适配、序列构建、骨干执行、动作头和部署适配解耦，并融合关键推理算子。
approach.en: After analyzing representative VLA and WAM designs, the authors separate input adaptation, sequence construction, backbone execution, head plugins, and deployment adaptation while fusing critical inference operations.

system_design.zh: 五层架构通过统一后端连接设备：适配器读取传感器，序列层按频率组装输入，骨干共享计算，插件头生成动作或世界状态，部署层接机器人和模拟器。
system_design.en: Five layers connect through one backend: adapters ingest sensors, sequence builders assemble rate-specific inputs, the backbone shares computation, plugin heads emit actions or world state, and deployment adapters target robots or simulators.

key_results.zh: 在两种 VLA 和初步 WAM 测试中，运行时支持成功闭环执行并降低模型块内存，显示统一抽象可兼顾效率和多架构支持。
key_results.en: Across two VLA deployments and a preliminary WAM test, the runtime supports successful closed-loop execution and lowers block memory, suggesting one abstraction can span architectures efficiently.

limitations.zh: WAM 证据仍属初步，五层接口尚未覆盖所有传感器、动作空间和控制频率；真实安全认证与更广后端可移植性仍待完成。
limitations.en: WAM evidence is preliminary, the five-layer API does not yet cover every sensor, action space, or control rate, and real safety certification plus broader backend portability remain open.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
